about: koha.nexus local gateway targets, generated by python -m nexus_gateway panel-list from enrichment/nexus_gateway/targets.json: every one is 127.0.0.1:5000/sru/<id>, answered from static.db and, for Z39.50/SRU catalogues, live. sru/_union searches them all and is the only one preselected. The last ones are authority files (recordtype authority) for Koha's authority search: sru/_union-aut on this gateway, then the others kept from the previous list.
